title: LLM for Everyone: Representing the Underrepresented in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot and few-shot performance on Natural Language Understanding (NLU) and Natural Language Generation (NLG) benchmarks across high-resource languages and various underrepresented indigenous languages.

Evaluating models on local-nuanced commonsense reasoning (COPAL-ID) and culturally-specific figures of speech (MABL), and mapping cultural value distributions using a high-dimensional Universal Value Representation (UniVaR) derived from LLM responses to value-eliciting questions.
